question: The required stopping expression contains completeness_score >= 0.90; what is that number and against what is it validated?
answer: VERIFIED: completeness_score is min of three declared-coverage ratios; held-out Spearman interval supports gating at 0.90 on this gold set. Formula: min-three-axis-declared-coverage-v1: completeness_score = min(subquestion_coverage, category_coverage, evidence_class_coverage) where each ratio is covered-declared/declared. A declared item is covered only by a qualifying record (>= 8 non-stop, non-padding content tokens; evidence classes must be cited). Extra undeclared volume is ignored. Empty declared lists are NOT-CHECKED and must not gate. Held-out n=12 Spearman rho=0.973012 bootstrap95=[0.8930628066197365, 0.9926738940125376] Fisher-z95=[0.9038110857343398, 0.9926211189529023]. Padded heldout.padded-volume score=0.0 (words=1592) stays below 0.9. Complete heldout.complete-a score=1.0 reaches it. Gold set command-center/p2-wave/probes/TST-0282/gold_set.json sha256=feef9b47e3157e4578c57c0fe1077b014560643a41867c585e59c08ad176b691. Stopping expression unique_ideas >= 100 AND completeness_score >= 0.90 may_bind=True. SUCCESS:TST-0282
